_comment: EVERYONE-BODY-MOCAP-OPPONENTS (2026-09-14). Each clip is a window of a real capture, retargeted by lib/babylon/anim/mocapRetarget.ts into lib/babylon/anim/authored/mocapOpponents.ts (npx tsx scripts/mocap/gen-opponent-clips.mts). `replaces` is the authored clip an OPPONENT plays this instead of (lib/babylon/anim/opponentMotion.ts). A beat keeps the duration of the clip it replaces so mode timing (the release, the settle) does not move; a loop keeps real time. Files are relative to ~/Downloads/fel-mocap-sources. Windows were read off scripts/mocap/stream-sheet.mts sheets and hand/foot signal tables.

clips.name: bball_mc_dribble_idle
clips.note: right-hand dribble, one bounce cycle (hand peaks 6.75 → 7.50)

clips.name: bball_mc_crossover_right
clips.note: low freestyle: the LEFT hand carries across to the right hip (going right)

clips.name: bball_mc_crossover_left
clips.note: the same capture mirrored

clips.name: bball_mc_hesi
clips.note: a hard low dribble: the ball hand drops to 1.16 torso, hips dip, then back up

clips.name: bball_mc_follow_through
clips.note: 124_05: the release held — the right hand stays up and forward, the left drops away (3.7), then the landing

clips.name: bball_mc_layup_gather
clips.note: basketball lay up: the gather low (2.2–2.9) into the rise, both hands carrying the ball up to 1.9 m · EXTEND (2026-09-17): the capture lifts two-handed at the rim; from a fifth in, the finishing hand eases up to the iron (2.12 m, forward) and the guide hand drops to the chest — the one-hand extension the release key (0.30 s of 0.7) lands on

clips.name: football_mc_run
clips.note: a defender's pursuit stride: CMU 78 RunningNoBall (the same cycle as bball_mc_run, in the football scope)

clips.name: bball_mc_pump_fake
clips.note: FakeShotBreakRight: from triple threat the ball rises to the set point (1.77 m at 2.1) and comes back down to the pocket — the fake, played at 0.7 s (HOOPS MOVEMENT 2026-09-15, hoops-timeline.mts)

clips.name: bball_mc_step_through
clips.note: FakeShotBreakRight: after the fake, the low load (hips −0.36 at 3.4) and the break past the defender — the step-through — played in 0.5 s, the step-through leg is 0.3 s (HoopsMoves.STEP_THROUGH_SEC_LEG)

clips.name: bball_mc_pivot
clips.note: Pivoting: the ball held at the chest (1.2–1.35 m), a reverse pivot swinging the hips ~110° on the planted foot — played in 0.55 s (the authored pivot was 0.42)

clips.name: bball_mc_layup_gather_left
clips.note: the layup capture mirrored: the left-hand finish · EXTEND (2026-09-17): the capture lifts two-handed at the rim; from a fifth in, the finishing hand eases up to the iron (2.12 m, forward) and the guide hand drops to the chest — the one-hand extension the release key (0.30 s of 0.7) lands on

clips.name: karate_mc_cross
clips.note: RECOGNISABLE ON SIGHT (2026-09-15, find-signature): the RIGHT straight driven 0.69 m in front at shoulder height (1.41 m) — CROSS (a shoulder-height boxing straight; the karate head-height punch photographed as a rising arm)

clips.name: karate_mc_uppercut
clips.note: RECOGNISABLE ON SIGHT (2026-09-15, find-signature): the RIGHT fist rising 0.74 m to 1.64 m, 0.32 m in front — UPPERCUT / RISING DRAGON (was a 0.45 m rise that stayed at the chin)

clips.name: karate_mc_whirl
clips.note: RECOGNISABLE ON SIGHT (2026-09-15, find-signature): a turning kick — the body comes round 178° and the foot rises to 1.41 m — WHIRLWIND (was a straight side kick with no turn)

clips.name: karate_mc_backspin
clips.note: THE HUNDRED distinct moves (2026-09-15): Yokogeri: LEFT side kick, foot 1.02 m at 10.94 — SPIN BACK KICK (pull back + B)

clips.name: karate_mc_typhoon
clips.note: RECOGNISABLE ON SIGHT (2026-09-15, find-signature): the jumping spin kick — 326° of turn with both feet 0.9 m off the floor and the kick at 1.10 m — TYPHOON, the airborne ender (was a 180° jumping twist with no kick)

clips.name: karate_mc_hammer
clips.note: RECOGNISABLE ON SIGHT (2026-09-15, find-signature): the RIGHT fist from above the head (1.80 m) driven down to 1.16 m, 0.71 m in front, in 0.30 s — HAMMER FIST (was gedan-barai, a low sweeping block)

clips.name: karate_mc_heavy
clips.note: THE HUNDRED distinct moves (2026-09-15): Oiduki: a planted right lunge punch, reach 0.53 m at 2.54 — HEAVY

clips.name: karate_mc_rush
clips.note: THE HUNDRED distinct moves (2026-09-15): Gedanbarai: a full step in (hips travel ~1 leg length 0.6–1.4) behind the strike — RUSH (push at + Y)

clips.name: karate_mc_stagger
clips.note: THE HUNDRED reactive enemies (2026-09-15): the guard broken — the body reels back off a medium / heavy hit without leaving its feet (the light flinch stays karate_mc_hit_react, a launch is the knockdown)

clips.name: bball_mc_pullup_gather
clips.note: crossover dribble, shoot: the pick-up off the last dribble into the dip (the hands come from the hip to the chest) — the pull-up's gather; the jumpshot capture takes it from the dip (2026-09-17)

clips.name: bball_mc_defend_backpedal
clips.note: DefensiveStraightNoStop: the retreat — hips at -0.3, a fast drop back while the chest stays on the man (2026-09-17)

clips.name: bball_mc_defend_slide_hard_right
clips.note: DefensiveRightStopToStop: the sat-down slide (hips -0.30..-0.43, four leg-lengths in a second) — intense D (2026-09-17)
